attachments.origin_landmark: subcutaneous fascia of the upper chest (pectoral/deltoid fascia)
attachments.insertion_landmark: mandible and skin of the lower face (dermal)

actions: tenses neck skin, depresses mandible/lower lip, assists forced expiration by tensing the deep cervical fascia

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The most caudally-placed muscle of facial expression -- a thin sheet spanning from the chest wall fascia up into the lower face, unusually long and thin for a facial-expression muscle.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.method: Sihler-stained cadaveric dissection translated into an ultrasound-guided clinical injection protocol (40 patients)
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Motor end-plates, supplied by the cervical branch of the facial nerve (with supplementary marginal mandibular branch supply to the uppermost part), cluster in the upper two-thirds of the platysma; the lower third is innervated mainly by sensory nerves (transverse cervical, great auricular, supraclavicular) and contributes little to dynamic banding. The underlying Sihler-staining nerve map is reported separately in Cho TH, Won SY, Yang HM, Clin Anat 36(2):277-284 (2022), doi:10.1002/ca.23984.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Yi KH, Wong IKJ, Wan J, J Cosmet Dermatol 24(7):e70301 (2025), doi:10.1111/jocd.70301 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jocd.70301) -- retrieved via PubMed

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Linear probe over the anterior neck, transverse or along a vertical platysmal band; injection sites concentrated in the upper two-thirds of the muscle and along the marginal mandibular border -- e.g. 5 points along the mandibular body, 5 at the mandibular border, and 5 approximately 1.5-2.0 cm below the mandibular border (15 points/side).
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial subdermal/subplatysmal plane; the muscle is thin and broad, immediately deep to the skin and superficial fat of the anterior neck.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Visible/palpable vertical bands on contraction (platysmal banding); ultrasound confirms the thin muscle layer and helps titrate injection depth, particularly in patients with thicker pre-platysmal fat.
structures_at_risk: deeper cervical strap muscles and neurovascular structures if the needle passes below the platysma (risk of dysphagia/dysphonia with over-deep injection)
marginal mandibular branch of the facial nerve near the mandibular border
transverse cervical, great auricular and supraclavicular nerves in the lower third (sensory; largely uninvolved in banding but nearby)
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: In a 40-patient series, concentrating 30-60 U BoNT-A per side in the motor-rich upper two-thirds under ultrasound guidance produced a >=2-grade reduction in dynamic bands in 92.5% of patients by week 4 (maintained to week 12), with a 35% reduction in mean toxin dose and no dysphagia or lower-face weakness versus historical whole-muscle dosing. The authors note this is a preliminary clinical series (no control/randomized comparison), anatomically grounded in prior Sihler-staining nerve mapping of the platysma.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Yi KH, Wong IKJ, Wan J, J Cosmet Dermatol 24(7):e70301 (2025), doi:10.1111/jocd.70301 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jocd.70301) -- retrieved via PubMed
